How these numbers are measured. An independent reviewer takes each manual snag and checks it against the AI repair list. Snag Recall 1 counts a manual snag when the AI entries give the correct repair work, under the correct trade, at the correct location; Snag Recall 2 additionally requires the AI text to describe the identical defect. Snag Yield compares snag counts at the same unit of measure: all AI observations of one physical object (a wall, a door, the floor) count as ONE snag — the manual list actually splits finer (one object often has several rows), so the yield understates the AI side. Only photo-confirmed AI snags count toward yield; 1232 observations that failed the photo re-check were discarded, and unconfirmed ones are marked "confirm on site" rather than counted. The v1 page's "73% recall" came from text matching that counted 34 AI findings as covering 183 manual snags; re-measured by the same independent reviewer, the previous AI system fully covered 22% and reached 50% of the manual snags.
